Notice the difference between a traditional PTM and a Celebration of Learning at Dibber? It’s those beaming, proud faces of parents witnessing their child's true growth. Learning is so much more than what fits on a marks card. 

Our Celebration of Learning at Dibber International Preschool, Bellandur, was about coming together to celebrate the experiences, discoveries, growing confidence, and everyday moments that make each child’s learning journey unique. 

It was a chance for parents and educators to look beyond numbers and recognise the questions asked, ideas explored, friendships formed, new skills discovered, and the many little steps forward along the way. 

Because every child’s learning journey is made up of so much more than marks and every step is worth celebrating.

Some moments are made even more special when they are shared across generations.

We celebrated Grandparents’ Day at Dibber International Preschool, Bellandur, with plenty of smiles, laughter, and beautiful moments shared between our young learners and their grandparents.

From spending time together to joining in the celebrations, it was a lovely opportunity for children to celebrate the special people who fill their lives with love, stories, and cherished memories.

A day filled with togetherness, joyful memories, and the warmth of family.

#dibberbellandur #dibberinternationalpreschools #grandparentsday #grandparentsdaycelebration #familytime #togetherness #younglearners #preschool #earlychildhoodeducation #bengalurupreschool

Laughter, creativity, and festive cheer filled our classrooms as we celebrated Krishna Janmashtami at Dibber International Preschool, Bellandur!

Our young learners explored the stories and traditions of this special day through expressive painting, music, and playful activities that brought the spirit of the festival alive. A wonderful day of sharing culture, sparking imagination, and creating happy memories together.

We celebrated Raksha Bandhan with colour, creativity, and a chance to learn about the beautiful tradition behind the festival.

At Dibber International Preschool, Bellandur, our young learners explored the significance of the rakhi and discovered how this special thread represents love, care, and the bonds we share with one another.

Through festive activities and conversations, children had the opportunity to learn about the traditions of Raksha Bandhan while enjoying the celebration together with their friends.

A day of discovering culture, celebrating bonds, and creating joyful memories.

#dibberinternationalpreschool #dibberbellandur #rakshabandhan #rakshabandhancelebration #indianfestivals #culturallearning #younglearners #preschool #earlychildhoodeducation #bengaluru

We celebrated Onam with colour, culture, and plenty of joyful moments! 🌼

Our young learners at Dibber International Preschool, Bellandur, came together to celebrate the spirit of Onam through festive activities, traditional elements, and lots of smiles.

It was a lovely opportunity for our children to learn more about the traditions of Kerala, celebrate together, and enjoy the festive spirit with their friends and educators.

A beautiful celebration of culture, togetherness, and happy memories.
